uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Banks Land $550 Million Fee Windfall on Record IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC awarded $550 million to the Wall Street banks working on its blockbuster IPO — more than they made on SpaceX, the previous title holder for the biggest debut ever.

uutiset.t: China Oil Demand Rebound Pivots on Two Crucial Factors, Stockpiling and Exports
uutiset.s: Changing consumption patterns will be driven by stockpiling and fuel-export policy.

uutiset.t: Citi Sees Africa Bond Sales Topping 2026 Record
uutiset.s: Citigroup expects the number of African sovereign-bond sales in 2027 to exceed this year's record as improving macroeconomic stability boosts investor appetite. Chief Africa correspondent Jennifer Zabasajja explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Gabon Seeks IMF Deal Next Month After Audit Shows Lower Debt
uutiset.s: Gabon expects to reach a deal with the International Monetary Fund for a new program by the end of the year and is settling arrears as it waits for the fund’s sign-off on a debt audit.

uutiset.t: Zimbabwe Asks Lenders for Grants to Repay What it Owes Them
uutiset.s: Zimbabwe has asked three multilateral banks for grants or loans to enable it to clear arrears on debt it took out from them so that it can access new facilities.

uutiset.t: Laprophan Raises $223 Million in Africa’s Largest Pharma IPO
uutiset.s: Laprophan raised 2.22 billion dirhams ($223 million) in an initial public offering on the Casablanca stock exchange, the largest flotation by an African pharmaceutical company.

uutiset.t: Citi Sees Romanian Carry Appeal With Budget Key for Bond Rally
uutiset.s: Romania’s local-currency bonds may offer more upside for investors following a recent rally if the country’s new government holds stable and further improves state finances, according to Citigroup Inc.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO Has Stock Bulls Dreaming of a Year-End Rally
uutiset.s: The IPO might be moment dip buyers have been waiting for.

uutiset.t: Trump, Xi and Putin Hold Unprecedented Trilateral Meeting
uutiset.s: President Donald Trump held an unprecedented trilateral meeting with his counterparts Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. The talks took place amid ongoing attempts to stabilize US-China ties and continued hostilities between Russia and Ukraine. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Koenigsegg Stake Sale Values Hyper-car Maker at €1.3 Billion
uutiset.s: Koenigsegg Automotive AB, the Swedish maker of multimillion-dollar track-focused cars, has sold a minority stake to a private equity firm owned by Temasek Holdings Pte, valuing the manufacturer at about €1.3 billion ($1.4 billion) as it weighs going public.

uutiset.t: UBS Plans to Shift Hundreds of Roles to India in Offshoring Push
uutiset.s: UBS Group AG is set to shift hundreds of roles across its group functions from Europe to India, as it seeks to rationalize its operations and reduce costs.

uutiset.t: Former Brexit Negotiator Barnier Welcomes UK-EU Cooperation
uutiset.s: "I'm very happy that the new prime minister of the UK, Andy Burnham, wants to build a new cooperation with the EU," says Michel Barnier, the European Union's former Brexit negotiator and former French prime minister. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, he also comments on the French presidential race.
Martha Beck fala sobre o impacto do plano fiscal na escolha do comando da Fazenda. Edição de Patricia Xavier. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO: $1.1 Billion of Shares Sold to European Retail Investors
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC sold $1.1 billion worth of stock to mom-and-pop investors in the UK and continental Europe as part of the biggest initial public offering of all time.

uutiset.t: Modi Calls on Indian Companies to Expand Global Ambitions
uutiset.s: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Indian companies to look beyond the domestic market and focus on global demand, telling business leaders Thursday that they should prepare to compete globally.
